Review of parse_network (request_changes): The spec states that comment lines are those whose first non-blank character is '#'. Your current implementation strips inline comments using `line.split('#', 1)[0]`, which is not requested and might lead to incorrect behavior if '#' appears within a record (though unlikely given the alphanumeric constraint). Please update the logic to only skip lines that start with '#' after stripping leading whitespace.
